listing.name: Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire — N64 / SotE-Recomp
listing.summary: Research this distinct N64 Shadows of the Empire implementation; the current MIT project grant does not resolve the retained package texture-provenance condition.
listing.download_block_reason: The exact 0.9.7 Windows and experimental Linux packages include two texture packs. The MIT project grant excludes game-derived and third-party media. Fresh acquisition remains held pending permission for the bundled content or a reviewed asset-clean package.

steps.title: Keep your permitted Windows copy together
steps.instruction: For an already permitted 0.9.7 Windows copy, keep its program and companion files together. Put your own USA Rev 2 original beside Shadows of the Empire.exe as sote.us.v1.2.z64. Verify upstream launch in that folder, then select the executable and its containing folder in Portcove. Save the details before choosing Play.

steps.title: Check the experimental Linux requirements
steps.instruction: Put your matching USA Rev 2 ROM in the permitted Linux kit as sote.us.v1.2.z64. The upstream Play.sh launcher uses glibc 2.43 or newer, libstdc++ with GLIBCXX_3.4.32, and Vulkan. Keep its own library folder beside the launcher. The publisher’s Linux run reached early gameplay and later showed solid-blue output. Preserve the working folder while those issues are investigated.

references.title: Preserve the working copy and player data
references.instruction: Before changing kits, keep saves, settings, custom texture packs and your own optional PC movies, voices and music. The upstream Windows release defaults to Vulkan on first launch and then remembers your renderer choice.

warnings: The release’s MIT grant applies to eligible project code. Use a copy and bundled components you are already permitted to use. Fresh package acquisition remains held.
